# Procura West

> Procura West is Amy-Marie Holland's contract procurement practice based in Calgary, Alberta. I provide procurement services for oil & gas, construction, mining, and industrial companies across Canada - remote or on-site. AI-augmented delivery for faster, more thorough results.

## What I Do

I handle the full procurement cycle on a contract or project basis. One specialist with 15 years of experience, amplified by AI.

- Full RFQ-to-PO process management (vendor qualification through PO placement and close-out)
- Contract formation, negotiation, and administration (MSA, T&M, subcontracts, CCDC)
- Vendor evaluation, onboarding, and qualification (including HSE and ESG screening)
- Bid evaluation and commercial comparison
- Services procurement and contractor sourcing
- RFX management (RFP, RFQ, RFI)
- Expediting and delivery tracking
- Spend analysis and reporting
- Contractor compliance tracking (COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks, ContractorCheck)
- Invoice review and three-way matching
- Change order administration
- Subcontractor management and onboarding
- Contract close-out and deficiency tracking
- Payment recovery (audit, demand letters, adjudication support)
- T&M and subcontract review
- Supply chain risk assessment
- Procurement gap analysis (8-area framework with findings, dollar estimates, and action plan)

## Industries I Serve

- **Oil & Gas**: SAGD operators, midstream companies, oilfield service providers. MSA negotiation, field ticket reconciliation, turnaround scoping, vendor compliance, long-lead procurement.
- **Construction**: General contractors, ICI builders, industrial constructors. Bid package development, sub-trade prequalification, contract buyout, CCDC contract administration.
- **Mining & Metals**: EPC procurement support, engineered-to-order equipment sourcing, global supplier management, Incoterms (EXW, FCA, DAP).
- **Industrial**: Manufacturing, process control, heavy equipment. Vendor onboarding, PO placement, fabrication tracking.

## Engagement Model

I work on a contract or project basis - not tiered monthly retainers. Pricing is scoped to the work: short-term projects, ongoing contract assignments, dedicated weekly resource, or focused assessments. Remote or on-site, your choice.

## AI Procurement Toolkit

A digital toolkit for organizations buying AI tools. Includes a risk scoring matrix, vendor scorecard, 107 screening questions, proposal comparison system, contract clause library, and implementation checklist. Available at procurawest.ca/toolkit.html.

## Procurement Gap Analysis

A focused assessment of your supply chain across eight areas: Sourcing & Purchasing, Vendor Management, Contract Management, Subcontractor Management, Spend Visibility, Process & Documentation, Compliance & Safety, and Risk & Supply Chain Resilience. You get specific findings, dollar estimates, and a clear action plan.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How does Procura West work?**
I work on contract or project assignments - the same way companies bring in any specialist. You get one experienced procurement professional, backed by AI tools that let me deliver faster and more thoroughly than a traditional hire.

**How much does contract procurement support cost?**
Pricing is based on scope, duration, and complexity. I quote per project or per contract - no tiered packages, no long-term commitments.

**What industries does Procura West serve?**
Oil & gas, construction, mining & metals, and industrial companies across Canada, typically with 50-500 employees.

**What is a Procurement Gap Analysis?**
A structured assessment of your supply chain across eight areas. You get specific findings, dollar estimates, and a clear action plan.

**Where is Procura West located?**
Calgary, Alberta. I serve clients across Canada including Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Ontario, with remote work available for clients anywhere.

**What compliance platforms does Procura West manage?**
COR, ISN, WCB, Avetta, ISNetworld, ComplyWorks, and ContractorCheck.

**Can Procura West handle the full PO cycle?**
Yes. I manage the complete RFQ-to-PO process: vendor pre-qualification, RFQ preparation and issue, bid evaluation and comparison, commercial negotiation, PO placement, expediting, and post-award tracking through close-out.

**Does Procura West work remotely?**
Yes. I work remote or on-site depending on client preference. I use the client's templates, ERP system, and processes.
